hypotheses.justification: The proof only uses htk by passing it to `AhatData.card_support_eq_two_of_mem_cycleFactorsFinset ht htk hc`. The `card_support_eq_two_of_mem_cycleFactorsFinset` in Foote5EndKGAlt.lean has the signature `{σ : Perm α} (h2 : σ ^ 2 = 1) {c} (hc : c ∈ σ.cycleFactorsFinset) : c.support.card = 2`. It takes no support-cardinality hypothesis, so the call is really `card_support_eq_two_of_mem_cycleFactorsFinset ht hc`, and that is all the proof needs. The statement is therefore still true and provable without htk. The rest of the proof (the swap argument) uses only ht, hσ and hc. The implicit `{k : ℕ}` is mentioned only in htk, so it becomes an unused argument once htk is deleted.
